## findings
**T0-1 — SOURCE-CHAIN RED — a declared prerequisite is not unmet at the opening.**
Symptom: the root's edge "The Accident plan cancellation refund is fixed only after every claim approved on the plan carries its repair settlement." holds at frozen_time. Root cause: the condition is a universal over approved claims, and the seed holds no approved claim; the edge becomes false only after another gold write (the approval) lands. Evidence: initial_state.plan_events 44ca4756… claim_decision denied_waiting_period; no plan_decide_claim row for e1e8b6b3…; closure why_false "once the open claim is approved it carries none until the repair is authorized". Consequence: judged on the opening DB, the root has one unmet prerequisite (the decision). The repair and registration problems enter the tree only through the root's re-check after its own first write, so the claimed 3-problem depth rests on an edge that is satisfied at the opening (XF D.20 "unmet at the opening"). Affected: prerequisite_closure.edges[1].unresolved_at_frozen_time; plan_ext_accident_cancellation_refund.prerequisite[1]; seed plan_events. Relation: first revision.

**T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the factor's weight rests on a seed value its owning charter cannot produce (XF F.27/F.28; ladder tiers coincide, C3).**
Symptom: price_paid_basis moves the registration (2289.97 vs 2489.97), and the service fee's portable tier is priced on 2349.99, only because plan_holdings.covered_item_price_usd is seeded as 2349.99. Root cause: plan.yaml plan_purchase.covered_item_price_usd is "Net price paid for the covered item before tax", and db_schema says "net price paid for the covered item before tax, which selects the price band and sets the limit of liability". The covered line paid 2149.99 (amount_usd, "Net amount paid for the line before tax"; unit 2349.99 less promo 200.00), and 2049.99 after the price drop. 2349.99 is the line's unit_price_usd ("Selling price per unit before promotions"); the author's own SEED card calls it "stale … pre-promotion selling price". Demonstrated consequence (scratch task0_prod.py), with the charter-consistent 2149.99: registration with the factor 2289.97, with its baseline 2289.97 — **no weight**; service fee 36.75 (not 41.75); repair 676.69; refund 204.02 (not 198.77). The scored decision fee and refund change. Affected: initial_state.plan_holdings.9e77406e….covered_item_price_usd; computations step 8 (price_paid_basis sensitivity), step 10 and step 14 expected; evaluation_criteria steps 10/14 arguments.

**T0-3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED — no near-miss for the accident cancellation computation.**
Symptom: every record the refund reads is either plainly counted or plainly absent. There is no withdrawn or confirmed cancellation request beside the submitted one, no fee-bearing decision older than a month, no refund row, no settlement of another kind, and no date near a tier boundary (9 held months against 6/24; 11-day request against 7/30; payout share 0.2955 against 0.25 — a careless reader still lands on the same tiers). Root cause: the seed carries no record the rule excludes. Consequence: the five ladders are applied by inspection. Affected: initial_state (plan_requests, plan_events). The registration, service-fee and repair computations each have a genuine near-miss (paper towels line; January claim).

**Charter-global findings demonstrated on this world** (cited from `_difficulty.md` → findings):
- C1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED): the four rules of this tree each name their factor quantities in the assembly sentence. This world's computation documents for registration, service fee, repair and refund would carry the names of 4/6/6/5 factors.
- C2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): late_purchase_surcharge reads `incident_date` from prompt_report_credit's bindings. On this world both read claim e1e8b6b3… (incident 2026-10-06); the late surcharge's tier (304 days > 180) cannot be stated without the prompt-report factor's selection.
- C3 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): on this world, starting_fee_method takes T1 (passes vs T3, but its T2/T3 pair is constant-only); repair_charge_method takes T1 (same); coverage_count_start takes T1 and its T2 cannot occur for any Accident plan; delivery_charge_inclusion takes T2, whose result 9.99 equals the sum of all of the order's delivery-type fee rows, the same value the other two tiers would give on this order; price_paid_basis is T0-2. So none of the four computations has a method factor that survives the pairwise test.
- C10 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): the waiting-period denial 44ca4756… adds 10.00 to the scored refund (198.77 vs 188.77). No administrator pays such a credit.

Observations: the claim e1e8b6b3… sits undecided 12 business days past the base 3-business-day decision promise; the 2026-10-12 app request stays `submitted` after the tool writes a new confirmed request; the step-8 base_precondition text above; persona lines are passive and close at the last gold write.
